name: sandtable-ai
description: Rehearse your AI agent on a simulated copy of your customer's world before it goes live: tau-bench-style simulations with stateful tools, policy invariants and pass^k.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.smoke: node dist/cli.js lint examples/freight && node dist/cli.js lint examples/clinic && node dist/cli.js run examples/freight --agent scripted:careful --user scripted --fail-under 100 --no-html && node dist/cli.js run examples/clinic --agent scripted:clinic-careful --user scripted --fail-under 100 --no-html
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && vitest run test/package.test.ts && node scripts/sync-version.mjs --check && node scripts/changelog.mjs check && npm run smoke
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && node scripts/changelog.mjs release && git add python plugin CHANGELOG.md
